title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Great Southern Bank Arena, Springfield
description: Missouri State University holds its fall commencement ceremonies for graduates, with a 10 am ceremony for the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and a 1:30 pm ceremony for the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required, guests are not limited per graduate, doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, and only clear bags are permitted; ceremonies are also livestreamed. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO.
